your_notes: รีเลย์ตัวเดียวป้องกันได้ทั้งกระแสเกินและกระแสขาด (Over + Under Current) เหมาะกับปั๊มและงานที่กลัวทั้งโหลดเกินและรันตัวเปล่า
title: DOUCR - Digital Over & Under Current Relay, 0.6–70 A, 220 V AC
range_short_desc: Digital over- and under-current protection relay
description: Digital current relay (datasheet designation uDOUCR) providing both over-current and under-current protection in one unit, adjustment range 0.6–70 A, control supply 220 V AC. MCU-based, with 7-segment LED display of trip cause and trip current, and auto / manual / electrical reset. Protects against overload, underload, phase loss, phase reversal and locked rotor (separate thresholds for starting and running).

feature_groups.title: Main Feature
items: Over and under current protection in a single relay
Displays trip cause and trip current

feature_groups.title: Protection functions
items: Locked rotor for starting, In > 2…10 times OC setting
Locked rotor for running, In > 1.5…5 times OC setting

rows: Product or component type : Protection relay
Product specific application : Over & under current
Mounting support : Panel, 35 mm DIN rail
Contacts type and composition : Common NCNO
Short-circuit and overload protection : By 4 A gG fuse
[Ue] rated operational voltage : 690 V AC 50…60 Hz (IEC 60947-4-1), 690 V AC (CSA), 600 V AC (UL)
Reset : Manual reset; electrical < 1 s by interruption of power supply
Time delay type : O-Time 0.5…30 s (definite), U-Time 0.5…30 s, D-Time 0.5…30 s or off
Connections - terminals : Control circuit 1 cable 1…2.5 mm² or 2 cables 1…1.5 mm² flexible, M3
Tightening torque : 0.8…1.2 N.m for control circuit cable, 4.7 mm head
Vibration resistance : 2 gn on 35 mm DIN rail, 4 gn on panel mounting (IEC 60068-2-6)
Dielectric strength : 2 kV between circuit, 1 kV between contact, 2 kV between case and circuit (IEC 60255-5)
[Ith] conventional free air thermal current : 5 A, control circuit
